A solution that stores the flow logs in Parquet format and uses Athena for analytics provides the most cost-effective solution. Parquet format optimizes the storage and analytics of log data. Athena integration provides serverless and on-demand analytics. This solution provides analytics in the most cost-effective manner.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html"VPC Flow Logs/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/supported-serdes.html"supported data formats in Athena/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/when-should-i-use-ate.html"when to use Athena/a.

question_content: pA company needs to migrate a Microsoft SQL Server 2019 database from an on-premises environment to the AWS Cloud. The database is 8 TB in size. The company wants to use Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL as the destination database. pWhich solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST downtime?

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse AWS DataSync to migrate the database. Read the DataSync stream from within AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to convert the database schema to RDS for PostgreSQL.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. DataSync is a service that you can use to migrate data to, from, and between AWS storage services. You can use DataSync to transfer file systems and object storage. AWS DMS is a managed data migration and data replication service that you can use to migrate databases to AWS. However, DataSync does not read from SQL Server or interface with AWS DMS. pLearn more about   href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/how-discovery-works.html"how DataSync works/a.pLearn more about   how to span style="text-decoration-line: underline;"a target="_blank" href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_SchemaConversion.html"convert database schemas by using AWS DMS/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the database. Use DMS Schema Conversion to convert the database schema to RDS for PostgreSQL.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. AWS DMS is a managed data migration and data replication service that you can use to migrate databases to AWS. DMS Schema Conversion is a fully managed feature of AWS DMS. You can use DMS Schema Conversion to convert database schemas and code objects that are part of the migration.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_SchemaConversion.html"how to convert database schemas by using AWS DMS/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html"AWS DMS/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the database. Run the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) on the destination database instance to convert the database schema to RDS for PostgreSQL.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. AWS DMS is a managed data migration and data replication service that you can use to migrate databases to AWS. You can use AWS SCT to convert existing database schemas from one database engine to another. However, AWS SCT is a standalone application that runs before the migration of the database. Therefore, AWS SCT cannot run on the destination database instance.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Converting.html"how to convert database schemas by using AWS SCT/a.pLearn more about span style="text-decoration-line: underline;"a target="_blank" href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html"AWS DMS/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the database. Use Amazon RDS Custom as the destination. Run the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) on the destination database instance to convert the database schema to RDS for PostgreSQL.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. AWS DMS is a managed data migration and data replication service that you can use to migrate databases to AWS. Amazon RDS Custom is a managed database service for legacy, custom, and packaged applications that need access to the OS and database environment. Amazon RDS Custom provides configuration, scaling, and access to the database and underlying OS. You can use AWS SCT to convert existing database schemas from one database engine to another. However, AWS SCT is a standalone application that runs before the migration of the database. Therefore, AWS SCT cannot run on the destination database instance.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Installing.html"how to install, verify, and update AWS SCT/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-custom.html"Amazon RDS Custom/a.pLearn more about span style="text-decoration-line: underline;"a target="_blank" href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html"AWS DMS/a.

question_content: pA company needs to send customer call data from its on-premises PostgreSQL database to AWS to generate near real-time insights. The solution must capture and load updates from operational data stores that run in the PostgreSQL database. The data changes continuously.pA data engineer configures an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) ongoing replication task. The task reads changes in near real time from the PostgreSQL source database transaction logs for each table. The task then sends the data to an Amazon Redshift cluster for processing.pThe data engineer discovers latency issues during the change data capture (CDC) of the task. The data engineer thinks that the PostgreSQL source database is causing the high latency.pWhich solution will confirm that the PostgreSQL database is the source of the high latency?

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the DMS task. Examine the CDCIncomingChanges metric to identify delays in the CDC from the source database.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. The CDCIncomingChanges metric provides the total number of change events at a point in time that are waiting to be applied to the target. Change events can include inserts, updates, and deletes. The CDCIncomingChanges metric is not a measure of the transaction change rate of the source endpoint. A large number for the transaction change rate could indicate that AWS DMS is unable to apply captured changes in a timely manner, which causes high target latency. Therefore, the CDCIncomingChanges metric alone is not indicative of high source latency.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Monitoring.html#CHAP_Monitoring.Metrics.Task"DMS replication task metrics/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pVerify that logical replication of the source database is configured in the postgresql.conf configuration file.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Logical replication of the source database must already be configured in AWS DMS to start the replication. Therefore, this solution is not the cause of high source latency.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.PostgreSQL.html#CHAP_Source.PostgreSQL.Prerequisites.CDC"how to enable CDC by using a PostgreSQL database as an AWS DMS source/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pEnable Amazon CloudWatch Logs for the DMS endpoint of the source database. Check for error messages.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. A solution that enables CloudWatch Logs for the DMS endpoint of the source database will help identify or monitor errors, warnings, and other database activity. However, this solution is not necessarily indicative of high source latency of the DMS replication task.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/WhatIsCloudWatchLogs.html"CloudWatch Logs/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_LogAccess.Concepts.PostgreSQL.html#USER_LogAccess.Concepts.PostgreSQL.PublishtoCloudWatchLogs"how to publish PostgreSQL logs to CloudWatch Logs/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Endpoints.html"AWS DMS endpoints/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the DMS task. Examine the CDCLatencySource metric to identify delays in the CDC from the source database.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. The CDCLatencySource metric is the gap between the last event that is captured from the source endpoint and the current system timestamp of the DMS instance. The CDCLatencySource metric is measured in seconds. The CDCLatencySource metric represents the latency between the source and the replication instance. A high CDCLatencySource value means that there is a delay in the process of capturing changes from the source.pLearn more about span style="text-decoration-line: underline;"a target="_blank" href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html"AWS DMS/a.pLearn more about span style="text-decoration-line: underline;"a target="_blank" href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Monitoring.html#CHAP_Monitoring.Metrics.Task"DMS replication task metrics/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Monitoring.html"how to monitor AWS DMS by using CloudWatch/a.

question_content: pA retail company uses AWS Glue for extract, transform, and load (ETL) operations on a dataset that contains information about customer orders. The company wants to implement specific validation rules to ensure data accuracy and consistency.pWhich solution will meet these requirements?

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse AWS Glue job bookmarks to track the data for accuracy and consistency.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. AWS Glue uses job bookmarks to track data that is processed in previous ETL job runs. Job bookmarks maintain state information. Therefore, job bookmarks can avoid reprocessing old data. However, job bookmarks do not support the addition of customized data checks to ensure data accuracy and consistency.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/monitor-continuations.html"how to track processed data by using job bookmarks/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate custom AWS Glue Data Quality rulesets to define specific data quality checks.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. Data Quality is a feature that you can use to measure the data quality of any dataset. You can use Data Quality to add customized data checks to ensure data accuracy and consistency. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/data-quality-rule-builder.html"Data Quality rule builder/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse the built-in AWS Glue Data Quality transforms for standard data quality validations.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Data Quality is a feature that you can use to measure the data quality of any dataset. You could use built-in transforms. However, you need to define specific rules in this case to include all the specific checks necessary. Therefore, this solution does not meet the requirements.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/tutorial-data-quality.html"how to evaluate data quality/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse AWS Glue Data Catalog to maintain a centralized data schema and metadata repository.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Data Catalog is a centralized data catalog for datasets that come from different sources on AWS. Data Catalog can help maintain metadata and data schemas. However, Data Catalog does not directly support the data quality rules creation.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/catalog-and-crawler.html"how crawlers interact with Data Catalog/a.

question_content: pA company uses Apache Airflow to orchestrate the company's current on-premises data pipelines. The company runs SQL data quality check tasks as part of the pipelines. The company wants to migrate the pipelines to AWS and to use AWS managed services.pWhich solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of refactoring?

answer_choices.choice_content: pSet up AWS Outposts in the AWS Region that is nearest to the location where the company uses Airflow. Migrate the servers into Outposts hosted Amazon EC2 instances. Update the pipelines to interact with the Outposts hosted EC2 instances instead of the on-premises pipelines.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Outposts is a hybrid cloud service that you can use to extend AWS infrastructure and services to on-premises environments. In this scenario, the company wants to migrate the pipelines to AWS and not extend its infrastructure. Therefore, you do not need to use Outposts.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/server-userguide/what-is-outposts.html"Outposts/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate a custom Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that contains the Airflow application and the code that the company needs to migrate. Use the custom AMI to deploy Amazon EC2 instances. Update the network connections to interact with the newly deployed EC2 instances.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. An AMI is a template that contains information necessary to launch an EC2 instance with specific software configurations. This solution requires you to create a custom AMI, deploy new EC2 instances, and update network connections. Therefore, this solution does not meet the requirement of least amount of refactoring. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/AMIs.html"AMIs/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html"EC2 instances/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pMigrate the existing Airflow orchestration configuration into Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA). Create the data quality checks during the ingestion to validate the data quality by using SQL tasks in Airflow.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. Amazon MWAA is a managed orchestration service for Airflow. You can use Amazon MWAA to set up and operate end-to-end data pipelines in the cloud at scale. A solution that migrates to Amazon MWAA can use the existing code. Therefore, this solution requires the least amount of refactoring. Additionally, this solution will give you the ability to integrate the existing data quality checks.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mwaa/latest/userguide/airflow-versions.html"Amazon MWAA/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pConvert the pipelines to AWS Step Functions workflows. Recreate the data quality checks in SQL as Python based AWS Lambda functions.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Step Functions is managed orchestration service that you can use for workflow automation. You can use Step Functions to orchestrate the pipelines. However, this solution would require additional refactoring. You would need to convert Airflow Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) syntax to be compatible with Step Functions. Additionally, to recreate the SQL data quality checks as Python based Lambda functions would require significant refactoring. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html"Step Functions/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html"Lambda/a.

question_content: pA company reads data from customer databases that run on Amazon RDS. The databases contain many inconsistent fields. For example, a customer record field that is named place_id in one database is named location_id in another database. The company needs to link customer records across different databases, even when customer record fields do not match.pWhich solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate a provisioned Amazon EMR cluster to process and analyze data in the databases. Connect to the Apache Zeppelin notebook. Use the FindMatches transform to find duplicate records in the data.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon EMR is a managed cluster platform. You can use Amazon EMR to process and analyze data by using big data frameworks such as Spark. Zeppelin is a web-based notebook that provides interactive data exploration. Zeppelin is included as part of Amazon EMR. However, to create a provisioned EMR cluster and manage the provisioned cluster requires significant operational overhead. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html"Amazon EMR/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ReleaseGuide/emr-zeppelin.html"Zeppelin/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the databases. Use the FindMatches transform to find duplicate records in the data. Evaluate and tune the transform by evaluating the performance and results.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. AWS Glue is a fully managed ETL service. You can use AWS Glue to crawl data sources and apply machine learning transforms. You can use the FindMatches transform to identify duplicate records in the data. You can evaluate and tune the FindMatches transform to optimize the results. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/catalog-and-crawler.html"how crawlers interact with Data Catalog/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/machine-learning-transform-tutorial.html#ml-transform-tutorial-crawler"the FindMatches transform in AWS Glue/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the databases. Use Amazon SageMaker to construct Apache Spark ML pipelines to find duplicate records in the data.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. AWS Glue is a fully managed ETL service. You can use AWS Glue to crawl data sources. SageMaker provides capabilities to build, train, and deploy machine learning models. However, you must manage model training scripts and model training jobs. Therefore, this solution requires additional operational overhead. A solution that uses the AWS Glue FindMatches transform would require less operational overhead. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/apache-spark.html"how to use Spark with SageMaker/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate a provisioned Amazon EMR cluster to process and analyze data in the databases. Connect to the Apache Zeppelin notebook. Use an Apache Spark ML model to find duplicate records in the data. Evaluate and tune the model by evaluating the performance and results.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon EMR is a managed cluster platform. You can use Amazon EMR to process and analyze data by using big data frameworks such as Spark. Zeppelin is a web-based notebook that provides interactive data exploration. Zeppelin is included as part of Amazon EMR. Spark is an open source analytics engine for large-scale data processing. You can use Spark machine learning pipelines on Amazon EMR to find duplicate records. However, to create a provisioned EMR cluster and manage the provisioned cluster requires significant operational overhead. To develop and manage your own Spark ML pipelines also requires additional operational overhead. A solution that uses the AWS Glue FindMatches transform would require less operational overhead. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ReleaseGuide/emr-spark-sagemaker.html"how to use Spark for machine learning on Amazon EMR/a.

question_content: pA company has implemented a lake house architecture in Amazon Redshift. The company needs to give users the ability to authenticate into Redshift query editor by using a third-party identity provider (IdP). pA data engineer must set up the authentication mechanism.pWhat is the first step the data engineer should take to meet this requirement?

answer_choices.choice_content: pRegister the third-party IdP as an identity provider in the configuration settings of the Redshift cluster.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon Redshift provides native IdP federation. Therefore, you can use your third-party IdP for authentication and permission management. To use this feature, you need to register the IdP with Amazon Redshift, not with the individual clusters.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/redshift-iam-access-control-native-idp.html#redshift-iam-access-control-native-idp-setup"how to set up an IdP on Amazon Redshift/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pRegister the third-party IdP as an identity provider from within Amazon Redshift.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. Amazon Redshift provides native IdP federation. Therefore, you can use your third-party IdP for authentication and permission management. To use this feature, you must first register the IdP with Amazon Redshift. Then, Amazon Redshift will trust the IdP for authentication. After you register the IdP, you can configure your Redshift clusters to use the registered IdP for authentication.pLearn more about span style="text-decoration-line: underline;"a target="_blank" href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/redshift-iam-access-control-native-idp.html#redshift-iam-access-control-native-idp-setup"how to set up an IdP on Amazon Redshift/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pRegister the third-party IdP as an identity provider for AWS Secrets Manager. Configure Amazon Redshift to use Secrets Manager to manage user credentials.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. You can use Secrets Manager to securely store and retrieve database credentials and other secrets. Secrets Manager does not provide authentication or identity federation capabilities. A solution that configures Secrets Manager would not allow Amazon Redshift to authenticate users through a third-party IdP.p  Learn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html"Secrets Manager/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pRegister the third-party IdP as an identity provider for AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Configure Amazon Redshift to use ACM to manage user credentials.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. ACM is a service that you can use to provision, manage, and deploy public and private SSL/TLS certificates. ACM does not provide authentication or identity federation capabilities. ACM certificates would not allow Amazon Redshift to authenticate users through a third-party IdP.p Learn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-overview.html"ACM/a.

question_content: pA company uses an AWS Lambda function to transfer files from a legacy SFTP environment to Amazon S3 buckets. The Lambda function is VPC enabled to ensure that all communications between the Lambda function and other AWS services that are in the same VPC environment will occur over a secure network. pThe Lambda function is able to connect to the SFTP environment successfully. However, when the Lambda function attempts to upload files to the S3 buckets, the Lambda function returns timeout errors. A data engineer must resolve the timeout issues in a secure way. pWhich solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate a NAT gateway in the public subnet of the VPC. Route network traffic to the NAT gateway.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. You can use a NAT gateway so that instances in a private subnet can connect to services outside your VPC. This solution would use the public S3 endpoints. This solution would incur additional charges for each hour that the NAT gateway is provisioned and each gigabyte of data that the NAT gateway processes. Therefore, this is not the most cost-effective solution to upload files to Amazon S3 from a VPC enabled Lambda function.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html"NAT gateways/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate a VPC gateway endpoint for Amazon S3. Route network traffic to the VPC gateway endpoint.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. VPC gateway endpoints provide reliable connectivity to Amazon S3 without the need for an internet gateway or a NAT device for your VPC. There is no additional charge to use gateway endpoints. This solution is the most cost-effective option to upload files to S3 buckets from a VPC enabled Lambda function.p Learn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latestrivatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html"gateway endpoints for Amazon S3/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate a VPC interface endpoint for Amazon S3. Route network traffic to the VPC interface endpoint.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Interface endpoints are represented by one or more elastic network interfaces. The elastic network interfaces are assigned private IP addresses from subnets in your VPC. Requests to Amazon S3 over interface endpoints stay on the AWS network. You can use an interface endpoint to upload files to Amazon S3 from a VPC enabled Lambda function. However, this is not the most cost-effective solution because there is an additional charge for interface endpoints. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguiderivatelink-interface-endpoints.html"interface endpoints for Amazon S3/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse a VPC internet gateway to connect to the internet. Route network traffic to the VPC internet gateway.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. An internet gateway is a VPC component that provides communication between your VPC and the internet. You cannot use an internet gateway directly for a VPC enabled Lambda function. An internet gateway works only with resources that have a public IP address. When you configure a VPC connection for Lambda function, you use elastic network interfaces. Elastic network interfaces have private IP addresses.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html"internet gateways/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/foundation-networking.html"Lambda VPC configuration/a.

question_content: pA company stores customer data tables that include customer addresses in an AWS Lake Formation data lake. To comply with new regulations, the company must ensure that users cannot access data for customers who are in Canada.pThe company needs a solution that will prevent user access to rows for customers who are in Canada.pWhich solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

answer_choices.choice_content: pSet a row-level filter to prevent user access to a row where the country is Canada.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. Lake Formation is a service used to govern, access, and share data to build scalable and flexible analytics and machine learning (ML) solutions. Lake Formation also allows for controlling access to data at a fine-grained level, including column-level access, cell-level access, and row-level access. Using a row-level filter will allow the company to prevent access to rows for customers who have the value of Canada for the country column. This solution has the least operational effort and meets the requirements.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/cbac-tutorial.html"how to secure data lakes with row-level access control/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an IAM role that restricts user access to an address where the country is Canada.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) is a service focused on securely controlling access to AWS resources. You can use IAM to set permissions to control which AWS resources your users can access. IAM uses roles and policies to control access. An IAM role is an IAM identity that can be created with specific permissions, and permissions are set using IAM policies. Even though IAM allows you to control access to data at a table, database, and bucket level, IAM cannot restrict access to specific rows based on specific column values.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html"IAM roles/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html"IAM policies and permissions/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/lf-permissions-overview.html"Lake Formation permissions/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pSet a column-level filter to prevent user access to a row where the country is Canada.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Lake Formation is a service used to govern, access, and share data to build scalable and flexible analytics and machine learning (ML) solutions. Lake Formation also allows for controlling access to data at a fine-grained level, including column-level access, cell-level access, and row-level access. In this solution, setting a column-level filter will exclude access to all the columns independently of the country set for a specific row.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/data-filters-about.html"data filters in Lake Formation/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pApply a tag to all rows where Canada is the country. Prevent user access where the tag is equal to "Canada".
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Lake Formation is a service used to govern, access, and share data to build scalable and flexible analytics and machine learning (ML) solutions. Lake Formation also allows for controlling access to data at a fine-grained level, including column-level access, cell-level access, and row-level access. One of the strategies to define permissions in Lake Formation is based on tags, the LF-TBAC or tag-based access control. You can attach tags to AWS Glue Data Catalog resources, Lake Formation principals, and table columns, but not to rows. Therefore, tagging rows is not applicable for this scenario.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/tag-based-access-control.html"tag-based access control in Lake Formation/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/TBAC-assigning-tags.html"how to assign tags to Data Catalog resources/a.

question_content: pA data engineer creates an AWS Lambda function to read objects from an Amazon S3 bucket and to load the objects into an Amazon DynamoDB table. The data engineer uses an AWS KMS key to encrypt the objects in the S3 bucket. pThe Lambda function execution role contains the AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess IAM managed policy and the AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole IAM managed policy. pThe execution role also includes the following inline IAM policy:pspan style="font-family: Courier New"{ pspan style="font-family: Courier New"    "Effect": "Allow", pspan style="font-family: Courier New"    "Action": [ "kms:Decrypt", "kms:Encrypt", "kms:CreateGrant", "kms:ListAliases" ], pspan style="font-family: Courier New"    "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:11-2222-3:444444444444:key/EXAMPLE-KEY"pspan style="font-family: Courier New"},pspan style="font-family: Courier New"{pspan style="font-family: Courier New"    "Effect": "Allow", pspan style="font-family: Courier New"    "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:ListBucket"], pspan style="font-family: Courier New"    "Resource": [ "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET", "arn:aws:s3:::DOC-EXAMPLE-BUCKET/*" ]pspan style="font-family: Courier New"}pWhen the data engineer attempts to run the function, the data engineer receives an access error.pWhat is the most likely reason that the data engineer receives an access error?

answer_choices.choice_content: pThe Lambda function execution role does not have a policy or statement that grants access to Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon CloudWatch is a monitoring service. You can use CloudWatch to collect and track metrics, to collect and monitor log files, and to set alarms. The missing privileges to CloudWatch Logs will not cause this error. The missing policy or statement that grants access to CloudWatch Logs will only prevent Lambda from creating a CloudWatch log group to publish CloudWatch logs.  pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-cloudwatchlogs.html"how to use CloudWatch Logs with Lambda/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pThe inline policy does not have all the actions that are necessary to access the KMS key.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) is a managed encryption service that you can use to secure data and manage keys on AWS. The inline policy in the scenario has all the necessary actions listed to allow a Lambda function to access the KMS key. Therefore, this explanation cannot be the reason for receiving an access error.  pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/iam-policies.html"how to use IAM policies in AWS KMS/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pThe data engineer did not add the Lambda function execution role to the KMS key access policy.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. Lambda is a serverless compute service that you can use to run code. DynamoDB is a managed NoSQL database service. The Lambda function has access to the DynamoDB database and S3 bucket. However, the function does not have privileges to use the KMS key to decrypt S3 objects. The KMS key access policy must be edited to grant the necessary privileges to the Lambda function execution role.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html"KMS key policies/a.pLearn more about href="https://repost.aws/knowledge-center/lambda-kmsaccessdeniedexception-errors"KMSAccessDeniedException errors/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pThe data engineer did not add the Lambda function execution role to the resource policy of the S3 bucket.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Lambda is a serverless compute service that you can use to run code. The Lambda function's execution role already includes the necessary permissions to access S3 objects. Additionally, there is no requirement to manually modify or edit the resource policy of the S3 bucket to explicitly grant access to the Lambda function. The Lambda function can interact with the S3 objects based on the permissions defined in its role.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html"Lambda execution role/a.

question_content: pA data engineer needs to set up a provisioned Amazon EMR cluster that uses the latest EMR version. The data engineer must ensure that data for the EMR cluster is encrypted at rest and in transit. pWhich solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

answer_choices.choice_content: pEnable SSL/TLS for the EMR cluster. Use EMR File System (EMRFS) for client-side encryption.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon EMR is a service that you can use to process and analyze vast amounts of data by using big data frameworks. SSL/TLS is a protocol that you can use to provide security for communication in transit across the network. A solution that enables SSL/TLS for an EMR cluster encrypts data in transit between nodes. However, SSL/TLS does not provide encryption at rest. EMRFS is an implementation of Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS). All EMR clusters can use EMRFS to read and write files from Amazon EMR directly to Amazon S3. EMRFS can encrypt data at rest in Amazon S3. However, EMRFS does not encrypt data within the EMR cluster. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-security-configurations.html"security configurations in an EMR cluster/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ReleaseGuide/emr-fs.html"EMRFS/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse the security configuration feature of Amazon EMR to set up the required encryption.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. Amazon EMR is a service that you can use to process and analyze vast amounts of data by using big data frameworks. Amazon EMR has a security configuration feature that you can use to set encryption settings for data in transit and data at rest.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-overview.html"EMR clusters and nodes/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-data-encryption.html"how to encrypt data at rest and in transit in EMR clusters/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pSet up IAM policies that allow the EMR cluster to enable encryption.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon EMR is a service that you can use to process and analyze vast amounts of data by using big data frameworks. AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) manages permissions that control which AWS resources users can access. IAM can control who is authenticated and authorized to use different AWS resources. IAM does not directly configure encryption settings within the EMR cluster itself.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/intro-structure.html"how IAM works/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pInstall custom encryption software on the EMR cluster nodes. Configure encryption for communication with all nodes.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon EMR is a service that you can use to process and analyze vast amounts of data by using big data frameworks. This solution adds unnecessary complexity and operational overhead to create custom encryption software. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-data-encryption.html"how to encrypt data at rest and in transit in EMR clusters/a.

question_content: pA company uses a data lake that is based on an Amazon S3 bucket. To comply with regulations, the company must apply two layers of server-side encryption to files that are uploaded to the S3 bucket. The company wants to use an AWS Lambda function to apply the necessary encryption.pWhich solution will meet these requirements?

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse both server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) and the Amazon S3 Encryption Client.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. SSE-KMS provides server-side encryption with keys that are managed by AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). The S3 Encryption Client is a client-side encryption tool that you can use to encrypt data before you upload the data to Amazon S3. This solution does not provide two layers of encryption to data that is already uploaded to Amazon S3.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazon-s3-encryption-client/latest/developerguide/what-is-s3-encryption-client.html"the S3 Encryption Client/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html"SSE-KMS/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse dual-layer server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (DSSE-KMS).
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. DSSE-KMS provides server-side encryption to protect data at rest. DSSE-KMS provides two individual layers of object-level encryption. DSSE-KMS provides better protection of sensitive data than a single layer of encryption. DSSE-KMS also helps to meet compliance and regulatory requirements that require multiple layers of encryption. DSSE-KMS meets the requirements because a dual layer of encryption will be applied at the time of data upload. Additionally, you can use a Lambda function to apply the necessary encryption.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingDSSEncryption.html"DSSE-KMS/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C) before files are uploaded.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. SSE-C provides server-side encryption with customer-provided keys to protect data at rest. SSE-C provides you with more control over the keys because the keys are managed on the client side. SSE-C requires additional operational overhead to manage keys. Additionally, SSE-C provides only a single layer of encryption.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ServerSideEncryptionCustomerKeys.html"SSE-C/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. SSE-KMS provides server-side encryption with keys that are managed by AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). SSE-KMS provides access management through a KMS key policy. SSE-KMS provides only a single layer of encryption.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html"SSE-KMS/a.

question_content: pA company has a large number of AWS accounts. The company wants a solution to audit activity for all the accounts. The company requires the ability to query logs for analysis.pWhich solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development and administrative effort?

answer_choices.choice_content: pCollect AWS CloudTrail logs in one Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Glue to convert the files to JSON format. Provide Amazon Athena access to the S3 bucket.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. CloudTrail logs collect and store historical event information from the AWS Management Console, AWS CLI, AWS SDKs, and APIs. This solution requires additional development and administrative effort. You would need to provision an S3 bucket and configure Athena to write the SQL scripts to query against the stored logs. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/get-and-view-cloudtrail-log-files.html"CloudTrail log files/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html"Athena/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse AWS CloudTrail Lake. Create an event data store for queries and analysis.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. CloudTrail Lake is a managed service that you can use to run SQL-based queries on your CloudTrail events in an event data store. This solution provides the necessary functionality with the least development and administrative effort.Learn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-lake.html"CloudTrail Lake/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCollect AWS CloudTrail logs in one Amazon S3 bucket. Load the CloudTrail logs into Amazon Redshift for queries and analysis.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. CloudTrail logs collect and store historical event information from the AWS Management Console, AWS CLI, AWS SDKs, and APIs. This solution requires additional development and administrative effort. You would need to provision an S3 bucket. You would need to deploy Amazon Redshift resources to load the log data from the S3 bucket by using the COPY command. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/logging-with-cloudtrail.html"CloudTrail and Amazon Redshift integration/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pEnable AWS CloudTrail in each of the company's AWS accounts. Collect CloudTrail logs in individual Amazon S3 buckets. Create a central AWS Glue Data Catalog. Give Amazon Athena access to the Data Catalog.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. CloudTrail logs collect and store historical event information from the AWS Management Console, AWS CLI, AWS SDKs, and APIs. This solution requires additional development and administrative effort. You would need to provision an S3 bucket. You would need to configure an ETL job within AWS Glue to transform the log data. You would need to configure Athena to write the SQL scripts to query against the stored logs. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/catalog-and-crawler.html"Data Catalog/a.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/glue-athena.html"Athena and Data Catalog integration/a.

question_content: pA company uses Amazon Redshift as a data warehouse. The company is expanding lines of business into new AWS Regions by creating new AWS accounts. The new AWS accounts that support the new lines of business need to be able to read the data that is in the data warehouse. However, the company does not want to move the data. pWhich solutions will give an AWS account administrator the ability to share the data? (Select TWO.)

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse Amazon Redshift data sharing to share the data to all Availability Zones.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon Redshift is a cloud-based data warehouse service. You cannot define Amazon Redshift data sharing at the Availability Zone level because data sharing is configured at the cluster level. Amazon Redshift data sharing is inaccessible for granular control and management within specific zones.  pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/datashare-overview.html"sharing data across clusters in Amazon Redshift/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse Amazon Redshift data sharing to share the data to all Regions.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. Amazon Redshift is a cloud-based data warehouse service. To use the datashare feature, a consumer account administrator can associate the datashare with an entire AWS account across all Regions.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/across-region.html"sharing data across Regions in Amazon Redshift/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse Amazon Redshift data sharing to share a specific Amazon Redshift external table with AWS accounts that are in another Region.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon Redshift is a cloud-based data warehouse service. You cannot use Amazon Redshift to add external schemas, tables, or late-binding views on external tables to datashares. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/considerations.html#limitations-datashare"limitations for data sharing/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse Amazon Redshift data sharing to share the data to a specific Region in an AWS account.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. Amazon Redshift is a cloud-based data warehouse service. To use the datashare feature, a consumer account administrator can associate the data share with a specific Region in an AWS account.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/across-region.html"sharing data across Regions in Amazon Redshift/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pUse Amazon Redshift data sharing to share the data to a specific Availability Zone in an AWS account.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon Redshift is a cloud-based data warehouse service. You cannot define Amazon Redshift data sharing at the Availability Zone level because data sharing is configured at the cluster level. Amazon Redshift data sharing is inaccessible for granular control and management within specific zones.  pLearn more about span style="text-decoration-line: underline;"a target="_blank" href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/datashare-overview.html"sharing data across clusters in Amazon Redshift/a.

question_content: pA data engineer runs extract, transform, and load (ETL) jobs to process data that is stored in tables in Amazon S3 buckets. The tables include a column named Contact Information that includes the phone numbers and email addresses of customers. pThe data engineer needs to hide the sensitive customer data from the data tables.pWhich solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an Amazon EMR job that runs code to find data that includes phone numbers and email addresses. Redact the data that the EMR job finds.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Amazon EMR is a managed cluster platform that you can use to process large amounts of data. You can create an Amazon EMR job to find sensitive data. However, a solution that uses Amazon EMR requires compute-intensive code. Therefore, this solution requires additional operational overhead. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/EMR-Serverless-UserGuide/jobs-spark.html"how to run jobs on Amazon EMR/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an AWS Glue job that runs code to find data that includes phone numbers and email addresses. Redact the data that the AWS Glue job finds.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. AWS Glue gives you the ability to create and run data integration jobs from multiple sources. A solution that creates an AWS Glue job requires compute-intensive code. Therefore, this solution requires additional operational overhead.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-job.html"how to run jobs in AWS Glue/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an AWS Glue job that uses the Detect PII transform to find data that includes phone numbers and email addresses. Redact the data that the AWS Glue job finds.
answer_choices.solution_content: pCorrect. AWS Glue gives you the ability to create and run data integration jobs from multiple sources. AWS Glue has a built-in detection feature named Detect PII that can identify and process sensitive data. A solution that uses this feature will reduce the operational overhead because the feature does not require additional development or compute-intensive coding.pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/detect-PII.html"how to detect and process sensitive data on AWS Glue/a.

answer_choices.choice_content: pCreate an AWS Lambda function that calls the Amazon Comprehend API to find data that includes phone numbers and email addresses. Redact the data that the Amazon Comprehend API finds.
answer_choices.solution_content: pIncorrect. Lambda is a service that gives you the ability to build and run applications without the need to deploy or manage servers. You can use the Amazon Comprehend API to detect personally identifiable information (PII) data. However, to create and invoke a Lambda function, you need to develop code. Therefore, this solution requires additional operational overhead. pLearn more about href="https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/getting-started.html"how to create functions on Lambda/a.
